rules.reason: A file whose main code only declares compiles to declaration opcodes and a constant `return`; opcov reports no executable line for it (ADR 0003, docs/adr/0003-declarations-only-files.md), PCOV and Xdebug report the `return` line at the end of the file.

entries.reason: Precision case: the unexecuted last arm of a multi-line match over an enum shares line 9 with the `FREE`, `VERIFY_RETURN_TYPE` and `RETURN` that consume the match result; PCOV and Xdebug mark the line covered whenever the match ran, opcov does not probe consumer opcodes (docs/configuration.md, Executable lines).

Xdebug 3.5.3 artifact: in a generator, Xdebug records neither the hit nor the outgoing edges of the block the body runs in right after the generator starts or resumes (the code after GENERATOR_CREATE or a yield runs in a new execution segment). Reproduced outside the suite: in `function g($a) { $x = yield 1; if ($a) { echo ''; } return 2; }` resumed with `send()`, Xdebug reports branch 0 with hit 0 and both edges not taken while the `if` body's branch has hit 1; the same code without `yield` reports the edge taken. Here the generator's first block holds `foreach`'s `FE_RESET`, so its `LoopEnter` edge is missing from Xdebug's data although the loop body ran.

Xdebug 3.5.3 artifact: in a generator, Xdebug records neither the hit nor the outgoing edges of the block the body runs in right after the generator starts or resumes (the code after GENERATOR_CREATE or a yield runs in a new execution segment). Reproduced outside the suite: in `function g($a) { $x = yield 1; if ($a) { echo ''; } return 2; }` resumed with `send()`, Xdebug reports branch 0 with hit 0 and both edges not taken while the `if` body's branch has hit 1; the same code without `yield` reports the edge taken. Here the block that resumes after `yield from` ends in the `if ($more)` jump, so its `IfFalse` edge is missing from Xdebug's data although the generator returned through it.
A property hook that never ran is invisible to PCOV and Xdebug (neither walks property hooks); opcov reports its line as executable and not covered.
